name: ai-archetype-identifier
description: An interactive app that helps users identify their AI utilization archetype based on their goals. The app uses Gemini to analyze user input and match it to predefined archetypes.

scripts.start: echo "To run this project, serve the index.html file with a simple web server." && echo "You can use a tool like 'live-server' or the VS Code Live Server extension."
